draft: I returned a cordless vacuum cleaner to an online retailer on XX/XX/XXXX and have the carrier tracking number showing that it was delivered back to them. The merchant also sent an email confirming the return and stating that I would receive a refund of $XXXX. However, after six weeks, the refund still hasn't been posted to my credit card. I contacted the card issuer to dispute this charge, and they advised me to wait. I followed their instructions and waited the recommended time, but there has been no change. I believe the issue should be resolved promptly since the product was returned and acknowledged by the seller.

My wallet was stolen from my gym locker on XX/XX/XXXX, and within two hours, someone used my credit card to make purchases totaling $XXXX at two gas stations and one electronics store. I immediately reported this to the police and contacted my credit card issuer to inform them about the theft. Despite doing everything right, these unauthorized charges still appear on my account. I am requesting that these fraudulent charges be removed and that I be issued a new card to prevent any further misuse. This has been a very stressful experience, and I need this resolved as soon as possible.

I recently noticed three unauthorised transactions on my credit card statement from a retailer based in another country. I have never made a purchase from this retailer and did not authorise these charges. I still possess my credit card and it has not left my possession. The first transaction occurred on XX/XX/XXXX for £XXXX.XX, followed by two more on XX/XX/XXXX for £XXXX.XX each. I have contacted the retailer but have received no response. I am concerned about how these charges appeared on my account and request immediate investigation and reversal of these transactions.

I recently discovered a new credit card account on my credit report that I didn't open. I got a statement in the mail for this card with a balance of $XXXX and some charges I didn't make. I've never applied for this card, and I'm sure I didn't make those purchases. It looks like someone used my name and Social Security number to open this account. Now, this is affecting my credit report. I need this account closed and removed from my report as soon as possible. This is causing me a lot of stress and I need this resolved right away.

I recently went on a trip and when I came back, I found several charges on my credit card statement that I didn’t make. My roommate at the time had taken my card from my desk drawer and used it for food deliveries and rideshare services over the weekend, totaling $XXXX. They did this without my knowledge or permission. Now, they have moved out and won't respond to my messages. These charges were made while I was away and I didn’t authorize them. I’m reaching out to have these charges removed from my account.

Hola, quiero reportar que aparecieron tres cargos en mi tarjeta de crédito de un centro comercial en otra ciudad. Nunca realicé estas compras y siempre he tenido la tarjeta conmigo. No autoricé a nadie para que hiciera estas transacciones. Los cargos no corresponden a mis actividades y están afectando mi historial crediticio. Solicito que se eliminen estos cargos de mi cuenta y que me proporcionen una nueva tarjeta para evitar futuros problemas. Agradezco su atención en este asunto.

I was in the hospital from XX/XX/XXXX to XX/XX/XXXX, and when I got home, I noticed some strange charges on my credit card statement. There were four transactions at a jewelry store in another state adding up to $XXXX. I didn't make these purchases, and I had my card with me the whole time I was in the hospital. I'm really confused about how these charges appeared on my account since I never left my room and certainly didn't go shopping. This has caused a lot of stress, and I need this resolved as soon as possible.

Last night, my credit card was stolen from my parked car while I was at a friend's house. When I woke up this morning, I noticed three unauthorized charges at a home improvement store totaling $XXXX. I immediately called the bank to report the theft and filed a police report. This has caused me a lot of stress, and I need this matter resolved quickly.

I called your company and was told that the $XXXX annual fee would be waived for the first year. I was very happy with this offer and went ahead with the application. However, when my first bill came, I saw the annual fee had been charged. I contacted customer service several times to get it reversed, but they keep saying there's nothing they can do. This is very frustrating because I was clearly promised that the fee would be waived. Can you please look into this and help me get the fee removed? Please respond in a normal friendly letter in plain English.

I signed up for a streaming service subscription myself, but I decided to cancel it on XX/XX/XXXX and followed all the steps to do so. I even have the confirmation email showing that my subscription was canceled. However, the company continues to charge me $XXXX every month after I canceled. This is not fraud, and my card was not stolen. I need these unauthorized charges refunded immediately since I clearly canceled the service.

I've been dealing with issues with my credit card account for over a month now, and I'm really frustrated. It all started when my automatic payment was supposed to post on the due date, but it didn't show up until two days later. Because of this delay, I got hit with a late fee and some interest charges. I called customer service right away to explain the situation and asked them to remove the late fee and interest, since it wasn't my fault.

The first time I called, I spent almost an hour on hold before someone finally picked up. They told me they would look into it and call me back within three business days. Of course, no one ever called back. So, I had to call again a few days later. This time, I spoke with someone who said they would escalate the issue and get back to me. Again, no callback. I had to call a third time, and this time I was transferred to a supervisor. The supervisor promised to review the case and send me an email with the resolution. I waited for a week, but I never received any email.

To make matters worse, my credit limit was suddenly reduced by $500. I didn’t understand why this happened since I’ve always been prompt with my payments. I called again to ask about this and was once more promised a callback that never materialized. Each time I called, I felt like I was hitting a brick wall. No one seemed to take responsibility for resolving the issues, and I was just passed around from one representative to another.

In addition to these issues, I noticed a charge on my statement that I didn’t recognize. There’s a $XXXX charge from a hotel in Miami dated XX/XX/2016. I was actually at home in Chicago that week, so I’m pretty sure I didn’t make this purchase. 

This whole experience has been incredibly frustrating. I feel like my concerns are being ignored, and I’m being penalized for something that isn’t even my fault. I’ve been a loyal customer for years, and this kind of treatment is unacceptable. I hope you can understand how upset I am about all of this.

Could you please look into refunding the late fee and interest? I would really appreciate it if you could resolve this as soon as possible.
